sn22.86:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
sn22.86:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā anurādho bhagavato avidūre araññakuṭikāyaṃ viharati.
sn22.86:1.3: atha kho sambahulā aññatitthiyā paribbājakā yenāyasmā anurādho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā anurādhena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
sn22.86:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantaṃ anurādhaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn22.86:1.5: yo so āvuso anurādha tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato imesu catūsu ṭhānesu paññāpayamāno paññapeti
sn22.86:1.6: hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vāti.
sn22.86:2.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā anurādho te aññatitthiye paribbājake etadavoca
sn22.86:2.2: yo so āvuso tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato aññatra imehi catūhi ṭhānehi paññāpayamāno paññapeti
sn22.86:2.3: hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vāti.
sn22.86:2.4: evaṃ vutte te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantaṃ anurādhaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn22.86:2.5: so cāyaṃ bhikkhu navo bhavissati acirapabbajito thero vā pana bālo abyattoti.
sn22.86:2.6: atha kho aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantaṃ anurādhaṃ navavādena ca bālavādena ca apasādetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu.
sn22.86:3.1: atha kho āyasmato anurādhassa acirapakkantesu tesu aññatitthiyesu paribbājakesu etadahosi
sn22.86:3.2: sace kho maṃ te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā uttariṃ puccheyyuṃ
sn22.86:3.3: kathaṃ byākaramāno na khvāhaṃ tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ vuttavādī ceva bhagavato assaṃ na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyaṃ dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyyaṃ na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupātogārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyyāti.
sn22.86:4.1: atha kho āyasmā anurādho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā anurādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn22.86:4.2: idhāhaṃ bhante bhagavato avidūre araññakuṭikāyaṃ viharāmi
sn22.86:4.3: atha kho bhante sambahulā aññatitthiyā paribbājakā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu …pe… maṃ etadavocuṃ
sn22.86:4.4: yo so āvuso anurādha tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato imesu catūsu ṭhānesu paññāpayamāno paññapeti
sn22.86:4.5: hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā
sn22.86:4.6: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vāti.
sn22.86:5.1: evaṃ vuttāhaṃ bhante te aññatitthiye paribbājake etadavocaṃ
sn22.86:5.2: yo so āvuso tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato aññatra imehi catūhi ṭhānehi paññāpayamāno paññapeti
sn22.86:5.4: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vāti.
sn22.86:5.5: evaṃ vutte bhante te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā maṃ etadavocuṃ
sn22.86:5.6: so cāyaṃ bhikkhu navo bhavissati acirapabbajito thero vā pana bālo abyattoti.
sn22.86:5.7: atha kho maṃ bhante te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā navavādena ca bālavādena ca apasādetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu.
sn22.86:6.1: tassa mayhaṃ bhante acirapakkantesu tesu aññatitthiyesu paribbājakesu etadahosi
sn22.86:6.2: sace kho maṃ te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā uttariṃ puccheyyuṃ
sn22.86:6.3: kathaṃ byākaramāno na khvāhaṃ tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ vuttavādī ceva bhagavato assaṃ na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyaṃ dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyyaṃ na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyyāti.
sn22.86:7.4: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn22.86:7.6: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn22.86:7.7: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
sn22.86:10.2: rūpaṃ. vedanā. saññā. saṅkhārā. viññāṇaṃ tathāgatoti samanupassasīti.
sn22.86:11.2: ayaṃ so arūpī avedano asaññī asaṅkhāro aviññāṇo tathāgatoti samanupassasīti.
sn22.86:12.1: ettha ca te anurādha diṭṭheva dhamme saccato tathato tathāgato anupalabbhiyamāno kallaṃ nu te taṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ
sn22.86:12.2: yo so āvuso tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto taṃ tathāgato aññatra imehi catūhi ṭhānehi paññāpayamāno paññapeti
sn22.86:12.3: hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vāti.
sn22.86:13.2: pubbe cāhaṃ anurādha etarahi ca dukkhañceva paññapemi dukkhassa ca nirodhanti.
